name: Verdant Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Verdant is a good-leaning covenant intelligent true dragon with moss and verdigris over ancient copper scales. It seeks to restore blighted lands and pursue despoilers. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Copper Jaws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Rooted Guardian
abilities.description: While touching natural earth, the dragon cannot be knocked back.

abilities.name: Verdigris Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and the target is Vulnerable while standing on the rooted ground, ending when they leave it. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Grasping Roots
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Choose up to two targets within Close range. Each must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained by roots until they escape with a successful Strength or Agility Roll.

abilities.name: Patient Regrowth
abilities.description: Once per scene, when the dragon marks HP while touching living ground, clear 1 marked HP after the damage resolves.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
